privacySections.title: What we collect
privacySections.body: We collect information you provide voluntarily when registering or getting in touch, such as your name, email address and phone number, along with sign-in details provided by the approved identity provider.

privacySections.title: How we use it
privacySections.body: We use the data to manage your account, apply your permissions, send the invitations and notifications you requested, and improve the service. We never sell your data or use it for advertising.

privacySections.title: Sharing
privacySections.body: We do not share your data with third parties except to run the service, such as the email or messaging provider, or when required by law.

privacySections.title: Your rights
privacySections.body: You may request access to your data, correction, or deletion through the Contact page on this website.

privacySections.title: Contact
privacySections.body: Any privacy question can be sent through the contact page available on the website.

termsSections.title: Account
termsSections.body: You use your personal account and a trusted sign-in provider, and you are responsible for keeping your account details secure.

termsSections.title: Content
termsSections.body: Posts and opinions are those of their authors and do not necessarily represent the official position of the community.

termsSections.title: Acceptable use
termsSections.body: Publishing material that is illegal, hateful, or harmful to others is not allowed.

termsSections.title: Changes
termsSections.body: We may update these terms as the service develops, and the update date will be shown at the top of this page.
